description: This file defines an interface 'Metrics' responsible for collecting and reporting various operational metrics related to device connections, telemetry messages, commands, and processing outcomes within an IoT platform. It includes method signatures for incrementing/decrementing connection counts, measuring processing times, and reporting message metrics, with a focus on tenant-specific metrics tracking.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: Interface for collecting and reporting various device and message metrics within the platform.

methods.name: incrementConnections
methods.description: Reports a newly established authenticated device connection for a given tenant.

methods.name: decrementConnections
methods.description: Reports a closed authenticated device connection for a given tenant.

methods.name: incrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Reports a newly established unauthenticated device connection.

methods.name: decrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Reports a closed unauthenticated device connection.

methods.name: getNumberOfConnections
methods.description: Retrieves the total current connections (both authenticated and unauthenticated).

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Creates and starts a new timer for measuring durations.

methods.name: reportTelemetry
methods.description: Reports telemetry or event messages, including payload size, outcome, QoS, and optional TTD status, while measuring processing time.

methods.name: reportCommand
methods.description: Reports command and control messages with payload size and processing outcome, along with timing metrics.
